verdict.rationale: Cloudflare says AI Gateway rules can be adjusted "from the dashboard or API." Dynamic routing can restrict each user, project, or team with budget and rate limits, so there is thin first-party evidence for programmatically managing budget rules. The pack does not document an admin API for creating gateways or provisioning keys. missing for 10: documented admin API endpoints for creating and managing gateways, programmatic key provisioning, explicit API-based budget creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can provision gateways, keys, and budgets programmatically through an admin API

citations.quote: Adjust rules instantly from the dashboard or API — no redeploys, no downtime.
Restricting each user/project/team with budget/rate limits
